components.name: Cursor
components.description: Replaces the native cursor with a custom one. Scoped to its children by default; pass `global` to take over the page. Touch devices and reduced motion are respected: no cursor on coarse pointers, no lag with reduced motion.

props.name: content
props.description: Your own cursor: an emoji, an `<svg>`, any node. Replaces the variant's shape.

props.name: trail
props.description: Add a trail behind any variant. `true` uses 8 echoes; a number sets the length.

props.name: global
props.description: Replace the cursor on the whole page instead of only inside `children`.

props.name: smoothing
props.description: How fast lagging layers catch up, 0–1. 1 is instant.

props.name: cursorClassName
props.description: Classes for the cursor overlay. `className` styles the scope wrapper.
